name: WF-228 — Final Closing Outcome → Verified Close, Profit Reconciliation & CRM Closeout

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json;const d=input.deal??input;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const outcome=String(d.closing_outcome??d.outcome??"").toLowerCase();const funding=String(d.funding_status??"").toLowerCase();const title=String(d.title_status??"").toLowerCase();const closing_date=d.closing_date??d.actual_closing_date??null;const gross=Number(d.gross_profit??d.assignment_fee??d.gross_assignment_profit??NaN);const costs=Number(d.closing_costs??d.total_costs??0);const net=Number(d.net_profit??(Number.isFinite(gross)?gross-costs:NaN));const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];let state="blocked",route="WF-126",reason="Verified close cannot be confirmed.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){reason="Missing transaction identity.";}else if(!["verified_close","closed","completed","closing_complete"].includes(outcome)){reason="Final closing outcome is not confirmed.";}else if(!["funded","complete","confirmed","closed"].includes(funding)){reason="Funding confirmation is missing.";}else if(!["clear","complete","confirmed","closed"].includes(title)){reason="Title/closing confirmation is missing.";}else if(!closing_date){reason="Actual closing date is missing.";}else if(!Number.isFinite(gross)||!Number.isFinite(net)){reason="Profit inputs are incomplete or invalid.";}else if(blockers.length){reason="Unresolved blockers prevent profit verification.";}else{state="verified_close";route="WF-229";reason="Closing, funding, title, and profit inputs are verified."; }return[{json:{workflow:"WF-228",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,closing_outcome:outcome,funding_status:funding,title_status:title,closing_date,gross_profit:Number.isFinite(gross)?gross:null,closing_costs:costs,net_profit:Number.isFinite(net)?net:null,blockers,state,route,reason,requires_human_review:state!=="verified_close"}}];
